correctness.rationale: The proof was reconstructed from the explicit graph definition and a complete acyclic matching on all 331 nonempty faces. The verifier checks all 975 Hasse covers, the 160 matched pairs, acyclicity, the critical inventory (one 0-cell, five 2-cells, five 3-cells), exact signed gradient-path cancellation giving a zero 5-by-5 Morse boundary, and independent full mod-2 boundary ranks 14, 61, 79, 6. With no critical 1-cells, the Morse 2-skeleton is a wedge of five 2-spheres; its simple connectivity and Hurewicz identify the zero cellular boundary vectors with null attaching classes for the five 3-cells.

value.rationale: The Petersen graph is a canonical cubic symmetric graph, and exact homotopy types of matching complexes are known only for limited graph families. This computation gives a natural finite benchmark with genuinely mixed adjacent homotopy dimensions, stronger than connectivity or Betti-number data alone; the vanishing integral Morse attaching matrix explains the exact wedge rather than merely its homology.
